description: Everything the private stats page shows for one link: totals (opens, unique viewers, reading time, completion), each page's time, reach and drop-off with page names, each viewer and visit, a daily timeline, downloads, countries, sources, files in a data room, and the settings that change how to read the numbers (email gate, view-only, expiry). Use it for 'who opened the pitch deck and which pages did they read?'. Reading this never counts as an open.

id.description: Link id (from create_tracked_link or list_my_links) or its token.

since.description: Time window: 24h, 7d, 30d, 4w, today, yesterday, all, or an ISO date/datetime such as 2026-10-01 (UTC unless an offset is given). Default all (all time). Window numbers, pages, viewers and timeline follow it.

name: get_link_analytics
title: In-depth analytics for one link
